Manufacturing isn’t an afterthought at Fixfast, it’s our core capability. At our UK facilities, we combine advanced automation with rigorous in-house testing to control consistency, traceability, and performance – from raw material to finished part. This integrated approach lets us move faster on customisation, continuously improve tolerances, and raise the bar on quality, durability, and safety. It’s how we help contractors, fabricators, and specifiers get it right on site. 

Our point of difference: we care more.

Our UK based Customer Service team and technical specialists will partner with you from design through to installation, answering queries, troubleshooting on site, and sharing practical guidance so your programme stays on track. Construction industry sectors we serve: 
          - Sheeting & Cladding 
          - Flat Roofing

Built for safety, built for tomorrow.
